author: Maria Edgeworth
description: "The Bracelets" by Maria Edgeworth is a children's story written in the mid-19th century, which falls within the Victorian era.
longDescription: This narrative explores themes of character, competition, and the moral education of youth, focusing on the virtues of amiability and industry.
